name: qlrisk_pnl_explain
title: P&L explain
description: Explain P&L per trade (actual, theta, factor terms, unexplained) to an end state of end_shocks or end_market_data. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "end_shocks": [{"factor": "EQ.SPX", "size_pct": -5, "shock_type": "relative"}]} gives P&L 2026-10-09 -> 2026-10-09: actual 20,346.77 USD, theta 0.00, unexplained 197.69 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
